meta.name: saga-orchestration
meta.description: Implement saga patterns for distributed transactions and cross-aggregate workflows. Use this skill when implementing distributed transactions across microservices where 2PC is unavailable, designing compensating actions for failed order workflows that span inventory, payment, and shipping services, building event-driven saga coordinators for travel booking systems that must roll back hotel, flight, and car rental reservations atomically, or debugging stuck saga states in production where compensation steps never complete.

copy.tagline: 让跨系统操作在失败时自动撤销
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的操作牵动多个系统,一步失败就要全部回退。
copy.tagline_en: Roll back failed steps across multiple systems to keep data consistent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your operation spans multiple systems and needs full rollback when any part fails

howto.what: Claude 会为跨微服务的分布式事务生成 saga 方案：有序步骤与补偿命令、编排器或协同式实现、每步超时配置和状态监控。
howto.when: 当你在没有 2PC 的微服务间实现分布式事务、为跨库存/支付/发货的订单流程设计补偿动作，或排查生产中卡住的 saga 状态时触发。

say.text: 帮我为跨库存、支付、发货的订单流程设计 saga 补偿步骤。
say.note: 会产出步骤与补偿命令清单。

say.text: 给这个协同式 saga 的每一步加上幂等键和超时配置。
say.note: 会补上幂等与逐步超时设置。

howto.what_en: Claude produces saga designs for distributed transactions: ordered steps with action and compensation commands, orchestrator or choreography code, per-step timeouts, and state monitoring.
howto.when_en: Triggered when implementing distributed transactions across services without 2PC, designing compensations for order workflows, or debugging stuck sagas in production.

say_en.text: Design saga compensation steps for an order spanning inventory and payment.
My saga is stuck in COMPENSATING and never reaches FAILED — how to debug?
say_en.note: Suggests DLQ and event handling fixes.

say_en.text: Add idempotency keys and per-step timeouts to my choreography saga.
